open: Positions of the five lifts and which platform each serves: not in any source read; OSM has none.
OSM maps no stairs/lifts to regional perrons 3 and 4; OSM platform refs 1/2 may not match Banedanmark's perron numbering.
Number of escalators: the fact sheet mentions escalators without a count; OSM has two.
Toilet fee/hours: DSB says only 'Drives af Køge Kommune'.
No shops at the station in any source.
Bus stops: not given by DSB; not checked with Movia.
No owner station plan found; bridge deck height not measured in any source.

answers.question: (no station-specific open questions were listed for Køge Nord)
answers.answer: Footbridge station: a 225 m enclosed bridge links the regional platforms 3/4 (København–Ringsted line) with the S-tog platforms 1/2 across the motorway. The owner-side fact sheet gives five lifts and five stairs plus escalators; OSM maps only two escalators and three stairs (to OSM platforms 1 and 2) and no lifts.
answers._source: Dissing+Weitling, "Køge Nord Station fact sheet", https://dissingweitling.com/assets/press/KØGE-NORD-STATION-FACT-SHEET.pdf, read 2026-10-30; OpenStreetMap (osmfacts extract), read 2026-10-30; https://www.dsb.dk/trafikinformation/stationer/koge-nord/, read 2026-10-30
